description:
As a child, 'Cheon-soo' was accused of being a liar while trying to show his superpowers to his classmates. After that, Cheon-soo, who left the neighborhood, returns after 7 years and is reunited with Daum at the school he transferred to. Contrary to the welcome difference, Daum keeps avoiding him... You're nothing but an alien!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=777853), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6515851)
